name: git-commit-suggestion
description: LLM-powered Conventional Commits suggestions from the staged diff. Bilingual EN+VI. Mistral free tier by default; BYOK for OpenAI/Anthropic/Groq; local Ollama; optional unofficial reverse-proxy provider.

gitCommitSuggestion.provider.description: Which LLM provider to use. 'auto' tries the no-key free providers in order (pollinations → duckduckgo → huggingface → bundled mistral default) and falls back on each failure. 'g4f' is an unofficial reverse proxy and requires enableUnofficialProviders=true.

gitCommitSuggestion.model.description: Override the default model for the chosen provider. Leave empty to use the provider's default (see config/providers.yml).

gitCommitSuggestion.language.description: Output language for suggestions. Each language is single-language; pick one and the entire panel + commit messages use it.

gitCommitSuggestion.detailLevel.description: How verbose the generated commit messages should be: concise (subject only), normal (subject + brief body), detailed (subject + multi-paragraph explanation).

gitCommitSuggestion.bestPractices.description: Best-practice rules the LLM must follow. Each rule maps to a line of prompt guidance.

gitCommitSuggestion.suggestionCount.description: How many suggestions to request from the LLM.

gitCommitSuggestion.maxDiffTokens.description: Maximum approximate tokens of diff content to send. Larger diffs are truncated file-by-file.

gitCommitSuggestion.enableUnofficialProv.description: Allow unofficial reverse-proxy providers (g4f). These violate upstream ToS, have no SLA, and may stop working without notice.

gitCommitSuggestion.customPromptPath.description: Absolute path to a custom prompts.yml overriding config/prompts.yml.

gitCommitSuggestion.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Ollama server base URL (only used when provider=ollama).

gitCommitSuggestion.showEmoji.description: Prepend a type emoji (✨🐛📝…) to the rendered commit message.

gitCommitSuggestion.showBody.description: Include the explanation body in the commit message. Disable for subject-only commits.

gitCommitSuggestion.showScope.description: Include the conventional-commits scope (e.g. 'auth' in 'feat(auth): …') in the rendered subject. Disable to render 'feat: …' instead.
